verdict.rationale: Orrick's Cyber, Privacy & Data Innovation practice page says the group helps clients "reduce cyber risk" and notes that its partners were named among the most sought-after advisors for incident response. That is indirect evidence the firm handles breach response, but it comes through a recognition mention rather than a description of the service itself. Missing for 10: a dedicated incident/breach-response page describing the service, any evidence of regulator-facing work (notifications, investigations, enforcement), and independent corroboration.
